title: Moving a display into a showroom
script:
Woman: Keep the public lift free from ten. It’s our only step-free route upstairs.
Man: The freight lift is free at ten thirty. We need both movers for twenty minutes; one leaves at eleven. Office first?
Woman: Let’s not give the case a guided tour. Every handover needs a seal check. The driver can wait.
Man: At eleven the room shows as available, and the display can run. Facilities inspects at eleven thirty.
Woman: The screen shows bookings. Reception needs Facilities clearance before admitting visitors to see powered displays.

options.text: Start using the public lift at ten oh five.
Start using the freight lift at ten thirty-five.
Start using the freight lift at ten fifty.
Start using the freight lift at ten ten.

questions.prompt: What does the woman mean by a “guided tour”?

options.text: She thinks a worker should guide visitors while the case is being moved.
She wants to move the case out of the van promptly so the driver does not have to wait.
She prefers leaving the case in the office until someone can replace its seals.
She wants to avoid a stop in the office that would add another handover.

questions.prompt: Facilities clears the display, but the public lift is out of service. What should reception tell a visitor who needs step-free access?

options.text: Facilities must inspect the display again before you can go upstairs.
The display is cleared, but you’ll need to wait until the public lift is back in service.
You can use the freight lift while the public lift is out of service.
You can go upstairs if the booking screen says the room is available.
